### Strength in (Low) Numbers
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-july-29-2025.html
Passage: Judges 7:7
Points:
- God intentionally reduced Gideon’s army to ensure all credit for the victory went to Him.
- Believers often feel heavily outnumbered in a culture hostile to the Christian faith.
- Faithful followers must commit to prayer, Scripture, holiness, and witnessing regardless of opposition.
- When Christians prioritize obedience in spiritual battles, God takes care of the numbers.

### God, Gideon, and Glory
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-12-2023.html
Passage: Judges 7:2, 7
Points:
- Gideon's victory depended entirely on God's divine favor rather than human strategy or military strength.
- God whittled down the ranks to a helpless few so Israel would recognize His intervention.
- The Lord frequently chooses unlikely methods, human weakness, and humble means to display His power.
- Trusting God allows believers to step out in bold obedience without relying on self-sufficiency.
